Life of Phocion

Plutarch

Harvard Classics, Vol. 12

Plutarch’s Lives

Plutarch

This selection from 
Parallel Lives
 represents the best examples from the founder of an important vein of biographical writing: rather than attempt an historical account of a life, Plutarch aims to edify his readers by encouraging emulation of the best noble deeds and character traits of his subjects.
